title: Reve de Mer 3 Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Reve De Mer 3 Lockoff is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 7 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Redefine a luxurious and amenity-filled vacation with the Reve de Mer: 3 Lock off.
description_expanded: Description102 Savannah Street1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 3 TWINS* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details. Luxury Seaside Living in a Prime LocationRedefine your coastal getaway at Reve de Mer: 3 Bedroom Lock-Off, a beautifully appointed Seaside cottage designed for relaxation, connection, and convenience. Perfectly positioned near Seaside’s fitness center, swimming pool, green space, and private residential beach, this inviting home places the very best of Seaside just steps from your door.Inviting Porches & Seamless Indoor-Outdoor LivingBegin your mornings or unwind in the evenings on the expansive screened-in front porch, complete with a porch swing and classic rocking chairs—ideal for savoring a drink and the gentle coastal breeze. Step through the double glass doors into a warm and welcoming interior that blends comfort with effortless beach style.Open-Concept Living & Gourmet KitchenThe main living area features an open floor plan designed for gathering, lounging, and making memories. The fully equipped kitchen is both functional and inviting, offering ample seating and easy flow into the dining space. Just beyond, a second screened-in porch and outdoor grilling area create the perfect setting for everything from leisurely breakfasts to sunset dinners and late-night snacks.Comfortable First-Floor Sleeping RetreatsThe first-floor primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat after a day at the beach. This inviting suite features generous storage, a cozy window seat, a flat-screen TV, and a private ensuite bath with direct access to an outdoor shower—perfect for rinsing off after sandy adventures. Also on this level is a twin bedroom and a convenient half bath, ideal for additional guests.Second-Floor Bedrooms & Private BalconyUpstairs, two additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations and open directly onto a private balcony furnished with lounge chairs. This elevated outdoor space is perfect for soaking up the Seaside sunshine by day or stargazing under clear coastal skies by night.An Unforgettable Seaside EscapeWhether you spend your days on the sand, exploring Seaside’s charming streets, or simply relaxing on a shaded porch, Reve de Mer: 3 Bedroom Lock-Off offers everything you need for a luxurious and memorable beach vacation. Thoughtfully designed and ideally located, this Seaside favorite invites you to slow down, unwind, and enjoy the best of coastal living. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Not available during peak season. 5-night minimum Spring | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter FEATURES Private Seaside residential beach access at Savannah Pavilion, one of the largest private beaches on Scenic Highway 30AJust a 2-minute walk (176 yards) to beach accessTwo enclosed outdoor showers, ideal after beach daysSpacious gourmet kitchen, fully equipped with Calphalon and All-Clad cookwareHigh-speed WiFi throughout the homeTwo large LCD TVs with premium cable channelsCeiling fans in every room for added comfortSecond-floor sun deck overlooking the park and Seaside skylineScreened outdoor dining patio off the kitchen with gas grillPeacock Alley linens throughout — fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towelsFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes included (for two-bedroom and larger homes); golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf carts are not permitted for non-homeowners in Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed STR23-002374
